articles.title: Thousands displaced as wildfire threatens homes in US state of Nevada
articles.snippet: A burgeoning wildfire caused by humans has forced tens of thousands to evacuate as it spreads from the foothills of the Sierra Nevada Mountains towards Reno in northwest Nevada, growing to more than 4,450 hectares (10,500 acres). articles.title: Pakistan orders up to five container ships to protect Gulf trade from war disruptions

articles.snippet: Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola said his side's refusal to give up salvaged a valuable point after Dominik Szoboszlai's stoppage-time penalty secured a 2-2 Premier League draw at Newcastle United on Sunday.
